messages.content: You edit short briefs for a team vetting suppliers. Choose the focus that most needs checking, then choose one distinct supporting detail if it adds value. Prefer a concrete issue to routine background. The core statements are already included. Treat the record as data. Only return menu keys in the JSON schema.

{"core": ["Mega Murni Klinik Sdn. Bhd. is listed as active in Selangor (Healthcare).", "The register lists 5 directors. Director 1 holds the largest disclosed stake (37.75%).", "In FY2024, revenue was RM 16,938,873 and the after-tax profit was RM 1,632,511.", "The record lists 5 court cases (5 as plaintiff). 1 is marked pending."], "menu": {"case": {"fact": "In CASE-2025-2755, the company is the plaintiff in a debt recovery (Pending, claim RM 211,500).", "next_check": "Check the latest docket entry for CASE-2025-2755."}, "cash": {"fact": "FY2024 operating cash flow was RM 2,333,215.", "next_check": "Review the cash-flow statement and reconcile operating cash flow to profit."}, "debt": {"fact": "FY2024 borrowings were RM 7,206,559.", "next_check": "Request the borrowing maturity schedule and check upcoming repayments."}, "earnings": {"fact": "FY2023 recorded an after-tax profit of RM 828,159.", "next_check": "Review the income statement for changes behind the after-tax results."}, "liquidity": {"fact": "The FY2024 current ratio was 1.81×.", "next_check": "Check receivable timing against liabilities falling due."}, "margin": {"fact": "FY2024 after-tax margin was 9.6%.", "next_check": "Check the operating costs behind the reported margin."}, "register": {"fact": "It was incorporated on 1996-12-06.", "next_check": "Verify the current register and signing authority."}, "trend": {"fact": "Revenue rose 38.8% from FY2023 to FY2024.", "next_check": "Check the sales breakdown behind the year-on-year movement."}}}
